description: This file defines an actor `TestIsolationLock` for concurrency control, and an enum `TestIsolation` providing utility functions to temporarily modify environment variables and user defaults for testing purposes, with proper isolation and cleanup.

classes.name: TestIsolationLock
classes.description: An actor providing a simple concurrency lock mechanism for synchronization in tests.

methods.name: withIsolatedState
methods.description: Executes a given asynchronous closure with temporarily set environment variables and user defaults, restoring previous state afterward, ensuring isolation.

methods.name: withEnvValues
methods.description: Convenience method to execute a closure with specific environment variables, using `withIsolatedState`.

methods.name: withUserDefaultsValues
methods.description: Convenience method to execute a closure with specific user defaults, using `withIsolatedState`.

methods.name: tempConfigPath
methods.description: Generates a unique temporary file path for configuration files during testing.
